hints.title: Symmetrical Water Simulation
hints.text: Alice starts at index zero and Bob starts at index n minus one, stepping inward after each watering.

hints.title: Independent Refill Tracking
hints.text: When a gardener has strictly less water than the plant needs, refill to full capacity and count the event.

hints.title: Center Meeting Rule
hints.text: If Alice and Bob meet at the same plant, whoever has more water waters it, with ties broken in favor of Alice.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def minimumRefill(self, plants: list[int], capacityA: int, capacityB: int) -> int:
        left = 0
        right = len(plants) - 1
        water_a = capacityA
        water_b = capacityB
        refills = 0

        while left < right:
            if water_a < plants[left]:
                refills += 1
                water_a = capacityA
            water_a -= plants[left]
            left += 1

            if water_b < plants[right]:
                refills += 1
                water_b = capacityB
            water_b -= plants[right]
            right -= 1

        if left == right:
            if max(water_a, water_b) < plants[left]:
                refills += 1

        return refills
```

complexity.notes: Alice advances from left, Bob advances from right, and tie-breaking favors Alice at the midpoint.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating complex nested state steps without clear pointer convergence leads to index errors.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Two pointers simulate symmetrical watering with zero auxiliary array space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle distinct and midpoint watering rules cleanly.
